tei:div.tei:p: "$ (515)༄༅// dpal 'bri gung pa'i lugs kyi chos drug dril ba'i gdams pa bzhugs so/// /

(516)༄༅// gang gis chos kun bde ba'i rang bzhin las// 'gro 'ong med don stong nyid don gzigs pa// dzñā na sid+dhir grags pa'i dpal mnga' ba// bde ba'i 'byung gnas de la phyag byas te// de las 'ongs pa'i lam srol ma log cing*// ma 'khrul don zab myur lam ston byed pa'i// chos drug rtsa ba mdo tsam bstan 'di mtshar// de la thogs mar stan bde ba la// rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung*/ lag pa mnyam gzhag /dpung pa thad sor brgyang*/ sgal tshig bsrang*/ mgrin pa sgur/ lce ya rkan la sbyar/ mig sna rtser phab/ de ltar lus gnad dang ldan pa'i ngang nas/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro gzhi las// dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu rnyed par dka'// skyes bus don grub thob par 'gyur ba la// gal te 'di la phan pa ma bsgrub na// phyis nas yang dag 'byor bar ga la 'gyur// 'di 'dra'i lus 'di mi rtag 'chi bar nges// gnod mang rlung gis bdas pa'i mar me bzhin// skad cig mi rtag 'jig pa'i chos can te// 'gro drug gang gis gnas su skyes gyur kyang*// (517)bde ba'i go skabs ma mchis sdug bsngal rgyu// 'di dag dkar nag rgyu 'bras las yin phyir// thar 'dod mi dge spangs la dge ba bsgrub// zhes gsungs pa'i don dran pas/ gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro nyams su blang ba ni/ thog mar rgyud snod rung sgrub pa/ skyabs 'gro'i khrid ni// spyi bor rin chen seng khri pad nyi'i steng*// rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi sku// sngo sangs rdor dril bsnol 'dzin rin chen brgyan// nges pa lnga ldan longs sku'i tshul can la// brgyud pa'i bla ma 'khor gyi tshul du bzhugs// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod// bdag sogs nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// byang chub ma thob bar du skyabs su mchi// smon 'jug byang chub sems mchog bskyed par bgyi// lam 'dir zhugs te don gnyis bsgrub la brtson// bla ma 'khor bcas dgyes tshul spyi bor thim// gnyis pa sdig sgrib dag par byed pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas ni// spyi bor pad zla'i gdan la rdo rje sems// ston zla'i mdog can dar dang rin chen (518)brgyan// rdor dril 'dzin cing thugs kar zla steng hūm̐// yig brgya'i sngags las 'od 'phros phyogs bcu yi// sangs rgyas byang sems thugs rje 'di bsdus thim// sngags las 'od byung rang gi tshangs bug zhugs// sdig sgrib kun dag yig brgya'i bzlas par brtson// rdor sems zhal nas sdig sgrib dag ces gsungs// 'od zer dkar po'i tshul du rang la thim// gsum pa tshogs rdzogs par byed pa maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid ni// mdun du maṇ+ḍal dbus su rin chen khrir// rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sku// dkon mchog gsum dang yi dam lha tshogs bskor// gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla'i rgyan ldan dang*// lus ngag yid gsum ltos med maṇ+ḍal phul// tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs bla ma rang la thim// bzhi pa byin rlabs 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid ni// mdun du rin chen seng khri pad zla'i steng*// rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang sngon po// rin chen rgyan spras phyag gnyis rdor dril 'dzin// lha rdzas gos can brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor// gus pas gsol btab gnas gsum 'od zer 'phros// rang gi gnas gsum thim pas sgrib gsum dag

/dbang gsum thob cing bla ma 'khor dang bcas// 'od zhu rang la thim pas tshig dbang thob// dus gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i ngang du bzhag /gnyis 'dzin sems kyi dri ma sbyang ba'i phyir// bskyed rim bsgom zhing bzlas par bya ba ni// stong nyid ngang las chos 'byung pad nyi'i steng*// phag mo rtsa zhal chags tshul phag mgos mtshan// dmar mo phyag gnyis gri thod kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin// g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang rin chen rus pas brgyan// thugs kar nyi steng baṃ la sngags kyis bskor// skabs 'dir bzlas pa cung zad bya bar bshad// slar yang stong ra'i dbus su d+dhū ti sngo// (519)tshangs bug gsang gnas bar sleb g.yas g.yon du// ro rkyang dkar dmar yar sne sna bug sleb// mar sne cha dbyibs 'dus mdor tsaṇ+ḍa lī// a shad rno zhing tsha ba'i ngad ldan gsal// lto ba snying ga mgrin pa spyi bo bzhir// rtsa 'dab re bzhi brgyad dang bcu drug dang*// so gnyis tshangs bug kun+da haṃ gi dbyibs// thur bstan snying ga mgrin pa yab yum gyi// sa bon rtsa mdud tshul can gsal ba la// ro rkyang rlung sbud a shad sbar ba yis// gnas bzhi'i rtsa mdud bkrol te haṃ rig pas// dkar cha'i rgyun byung gsang gnas bar du slebs// slar yang lugs ldog bya zhing 'bar 'dzag bya// lus kun bde bas khyab cing sku bsring bya// lus kyi phyi nang me lces gang bsam bsdu// ras gos mal stan me yi dkyil 'khor la// lus kyang me dpung gsang gnas a shad las// 'bar ba'i me lces lus nang gang bsam nyal// rdzogs rim stod smad 'od zhu dmigs med bzhag /skabs 'dir 'khrul 'khor bya tshul gzhung na gsal// snying gar dbu nang pad steng rdo rje 'chang*// nas tsam thugs kar hūm̐ dang thig le las// 'od 'phros lus kyi phyi nang gtam gsal zhing*// gzhi lam 'bras bu'i 'od gsal mngon du gyur// mgrin par pad steng chon tshad rdo rje 'chang*// thugs ka oṃ dang a nu ta ra gsal// rang gi steng 'og nor bu'i rtser thig le// dkar dmar nag pa'i ngang du rmi lam bzung*// chos dang zang zing las kun rmi lam dang*// sgyu ma yin phyir dngos po grub pa med// ma dag sgyu lus me long gzugs brnyan bzhin// stod smad dga' sdug khyad par med mod kyis// chu zla lta bur med bzhin snang ba rigs// lha sku snang stong grags stong rig stong ste// (520)yod med mtha' dag sgyu lus 'ching ba grol// slar yang dhū ti'i nang du lte bar āḥ

/dmar po spyi bor k+ṣa dkar snying gar hūm̐// mthing gar gsal ba sems kyi ngo bo la// hig gi sgras bskul a yig hūm̐ la thim// hūm̐ yang steng skyod k+ṣa yig 'phul bar bsam// skabs 'dir a hika drag po mang du brjod// 'jog dus yi ge rang rang gnas su bskyal// las sbyor hūm̐ yig bla ma'i thugs kar thim// bar dor phra rags thim pa'i snang ba ste// sa chu me rlung rnam shes 'byung ba thim// zungs mi thub cing rdul skam drang chung zhing*// phyir dbyung dbugs ring nang du sdud mi thub// snang mched thob gsum phyi rtags zla nyi'i dbyibs// dkar lam dmar lam zhe sdang 'dod chags las// gyur pa'i rtog pa so gsum bzhi bcu 'gags// mched pa thob par thim tshe phyi rtags ni// mun pa 'dra ste gti mug las gyur pa'i// rtog pa bdun 'gag rang bzhin ma bsgoms pa'i// bde gsal sprin med nam mkha' lta bu 'byung*// de tshe shi ba shes dang gnas dang grogs// bar dor shes shing yi dam sku ru bsgom// pho mor skye phyir chags sdang mig ser 'byung*// de yang sgyu mar shes pas rab tu spang*// dus der rnam shes rlung gi bzhon pa can// yin phyir yi dam bsgom zhing bla ma dran// 'dod chags spangs pas mngal 'jug skye gnas khegs// bzhi bcu zhe dgur dag pa'i skye gnas 'grub// de ltar rtsa ba'i chos bzhi yan lag gnyis// don ldan yang dag brtsams pa'i dge ba dang*// dus gsum bsags dang dmigs med dge ba 'di// nges pa lnga ldan rdo rje 'chang chen po'i// go 'phang bla na med pa thob phyir bsngo// ces kha ton du'ang bya zhing don bsgoms pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing skyon thams cad dang bral ba yon tan thams cad ldan pa'i bdag nyid du 'gyur ro// (521)'dir smras pa// zab lam gdams pa'i snying po chos drug po// ma nor blo ldan don ldan don phyir du// 'jug bde nyung ngu'i byas te bkod pa 'di// thar 'dod skal ldan yongs kyi thugs la zhog

/ces pa 'di chos drug yig cha rnying pa rnams sor bzhag /rang nyid nyams su blang ba'i phyir dang*// gzhan yang bka' rgyud 'di nyid kyi lam srol 'dzin par 'dod pa gang dag gi don du// dpon po thar pa gling pa dang*// dge slong gling chung gnyis kyis bskul ba las// shākya'i dge slong thabs lam 'di nyid cung zad nyams su lon pa zla dgon du sbyar ba'o/// maṅga laṃ// (522)
